3. The grievance of the defacto complainant/petitioner is that the presence of the accused in the said case could not be procured due to the laxity of the Police in executing the Non Bailable Warrant against the accused.
4. As per order dated 08.08.2025, the remarks of the learned Magistrate was called for with regard to the relief sought for in this petition.

The writ petition stands closed as above.
